title: Tenma Saki — 100 Things I Want To Do〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Humhumhuuum♪ Humhuum♪

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Saki seems really happy about something.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah. She's been like this since morning.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe, because today's the day, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I've been looking forward to this since the day we decided we'd all go together♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That's fine, but make sure you can focus during practice.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yes, ma'am! Okay, let's head to the studio right away!
Main Street

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huuumhuhum♪ Humhuum♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Come on, everyone, hurry up!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: She's gotten even more hyper than before practice.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: The way she gets completely carried away from her excitement is exactly like Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. They're siblings, after all!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Humhuhuum♪ Ah... The queue is already so long!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Wow. I thought the craze already ended a while ago.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Shiho, how can you say that?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: This was the one thing I was looking forward to enjoying the most when I got discharged from the hospital!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Fine, fine. Let's join the queue and stop blocking the way.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hona, did you see how mean Shiho was to me?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It's okay! She said she'll buy extra toppings for you to make up for that. Didn't you, Shiho?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What... Don't put words in my mouth, Honami!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Extra tapioca pearls♪ Extra tapioca pearls♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Sigh...
Well, I guess I can afford some extra toppings...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Speaking of toppings, this shop is famous for having lots!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes. Practically half the menu is taken up by toppings. Oh, I can't decide...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe... My recommendation is the pudding!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: There's pudding?! Oh, there really is...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I've heard that the custard is not too sweet and goes super well with the bitter taste of the caramel sauce!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You've heard? So you haven't actually tried it before?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehehe... Anyone want to be the guinea pig?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hm... I guess I'll give it a go.
There's even a highly recommended sticker next to it on the menu.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Um... Doesn't that make it hard to tell whether you're drinking milk tea or eating pudding?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Ah! Sorry, Ichi!
I should have included you in the discussion too.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Um, I wasn't trying to exclude you or anything, I promise!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Hehe. I know that.
You were just trying to explain things to them, since it's their first time, right?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hey, the queue just moved. Let's go.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We didn't have to wait as long as I thought.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! Well, let's try the drinks now!

rows.Speaker: Ichika, Honami, & Shiho
rows.Line: Oh!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (You're not supposed to drink it so quickly!)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (The tapioca pearls will get stuck in her throat!)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Saki, stop!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Mhm?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Ah... Saki, why don't you slow down a little to fully savor the taste?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: She's right! All those extra tapioca pearls you added would be gone in a flash if you drank so quickly!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: And make sure you chew properly.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You girls didn't happen to think that I'd choke on the tapioca pearls or something, did you?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You meanies! I'm not that clumsy!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But you never know, right?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It's better to be safe than sorry.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You were so excited today, it wouldn't surprise me at all if something as silly as that did happen.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Don't be such worrywarts.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (This really brings back memories, though.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I hope we can all stay together forever, even if it's just for doing ordinary stuff like this every day!)
